items.source_notes: ADDED 2026-08-21. Shower drain was missing from this bath entirely. Direction: primaries get linear drains, all other baths get a square drain in matching metal finish. Bath 3 finish is plain chrome, so brand is open. Price comparison for a 4 in. square tile-in point drain in chrome: Delta DT062412 $107 list; Hansgrohe RainDrain Brilliance 4x4 set $828 list; GROHE has no US 4 in. square point drain. Delta selected on price. COST IS AN ESTIMATE at Delta x 0.55 ($58.85 from $107 list). The Delta multiplier is not on the Wieland quote S2478380 - it was back-calculated from the 3754 Claremont Studio 41 proposal S2343240 (04 Nov 2025, Edwin Colon), which has 9 Delta lines. Observed multipliers ran 0.4935 to 0.5704, median 0.5306, mean 0.5305; 0.55 chosen because current list prices are ~9 months newer than that proposal, which depresses the calculated figure, and because Studio 41's verified Brizo multiplier is 0.5496 and Delta Faucet Company owns Brizo. EDWIN MUST STILL QUOTE THIS. Note: T3559LF-WL appears twice on that proposal at two different net prices ($198.48 and $176.17), so Studio 41 Delta pricing is not perfectly uniform.
